messages:
Asha: Kicked off the new greenfield region GPU pool this morning. Quick recap and a few asks: we ran initial provisioning, nodes came up but some pods delayed KV-cache warmups. I pushed a smoke+soak plan below, need eyes on autoscaler targets and an ops checklist.

Tom: Thanks. Can you paste the failure symptoms you saw? slow pod scheduling or image pull?

Asha: Scheduling + delayed readiness. Logs show high kube-proxy conn churn and transient egress throttling to our registry. Example from node-17: 
```
kubectl -n runtime logs init-warm -c warmup
2026-02-24T14:02:11Z WARN registry fetch retry 5/5: GET registry.redwood-infra/llm-kernel: 429
2026-02-24T14:04:00Z INFO warmup complete but KV cache priming stalled for 3m
```

Diego: Looks like registry rate limits. For this region we haven't set up our registry mirror. We should either enable local mirror or stagger pod startups.

Asha: Staggering is part of the soak plan — see below. Also noticed autoscaler reacting too aggressively when warmups spike CPU (OOM killers not seen). Current cluster-autoscaler config: targetUtilization 0.6, scaleDownDelay 10m.

Tom: For launch I'd bump targetUtilization to 0.75 and increase scaleDownDelay to 20m to avoid thrash while warm caches populate. Also set minReplicaCount higher for GPU pools during priming.

Priya: Heads-up on cost: if we keep min nodes high for >6h we'll burn a lot. Suggest a staged schedule: high-min for first 2h for priming, then gradual downscale. We can do an override in the dedicated pool billing window to avoid alerts.

Asha: Proposed soak steps (short):
1) Smoke (0-30m) - 10 priming requests to exercise model KV loads, verify GPU readiness and network egress.
2) Warm ramp (30-120m) - ramp QPS to 30% of target, stagger 30s between batches to avoid registry spikes.
3) Soak (2-8h) - steady 50% QPS with TTL-based cache invalidation tests.
4) Burst test (8-9h) - simulated 2x QPS for 5m to validate autoscaler fallback.

Diego: Add these tuning knobs to the runtime config before soak: 
```yaml
runtime:
  kv_cache: enabled
  warmup_concurrency: 8
  registry_mirror: false  # set true if mirror available
```
Also enable prefix caching for common prompts.

Asha: Ops checklist before starting soak: @Tom to increase CA targetUtilization, @Diego to deploy warmup concurrency patch, @Priya to approve 2h elevated min nodes billing override. InfraBot should attach baseline metrics.

InfraBot: Attached baseline: cpu_p95=1200m, gpu_util=12%, pod_start_p95=45s, registry_429=0.9% (last 24h).

Tom: I changed CA to targetUtilization=0.75 and scaleDownDelay=20m in staging. I'll promote to region after Diego signoff.

Diego: Patch applied to edge and canary. Warmup_concurrency=8 seems to reduce KV stall on node-17 in canary run. Pod_start_p95 down to 22s.

Priya: Billing override approved for a 3h window starting at soak kickoff. We'll monitor spend and rollback if it looks runaway.

Asha: Starting Smoke now (t=0). Kicking off 10 priming requests. Will report back at 30m with metrics.

Tom: Oncall watching. If registry_429 > 2% revert to serial startup (1 pod every 60s).

Asha: (30m) Smoke complete: priming succeeded, registry_429 peaked at 1.7%, pod_start_p95=28s, gpu_util during warm ramp avg=35%. Proceeding to Warm ramp.

Diego: Reminder: after warm ramp we'll run a KV invalidation test: send TTL drop events and ensure cache refill latency < 500ms for 95th.

Asha: (2h) Warm ramp complete. Observations: autoscaler added 4 nodes on ramp, then held. Some transient 503s from router when scale event happened. Router timeouts increased to 1.8s p95 during scale.

Tom: Router timeouts OK but we should adjust fallback policy: increase request timeout to 3s during scaling windows and enable queueing at ingress for 30s. I'll open a tiny config PR.

Asha: Soak now running (steady 50% QPS). Early soak metrics attached by InfraBot.

InfraBot: Soak metrics snapshot: p50 latency=210ms, p95=680ms, cpu_p95=950m, gpu_util=48%, node_count=12. No OOMs. Registry_429 at 1.2%.

Priya: Cost check at 4h: spend rate ~1.9x baseline; within expected for priming and soak. We'll keep the 3h elevated min then start gradual scale-down.

Tom: After 6h, plan to drop min nodes by 40% and let CA converge. Also propose enabling cache persistence on a subset of nodes to reduce cold starts for frequent routes.

Asha: (8h) Burst test: fired 2x QPS for 5m. Autoscaler responded by adding 6 nodes, latency p95 peaked at 1.2s for 2 minutes then recovered. No node failures.

Diego: Good. Post-burst: recommend a follow-up run with registry mirror enabled next week to validate full launch. Also a network egress request to the cloud team to increase registry egress rate for this region during first-24h.

Priya: Approving registry egress increase for 24h window. Keep finance in loop if we need longer.

Asha: Handoff notes for next shift:
- CA settings: targetUtilization=0.75, scaleDownDelay=20m, minNodes during priming=16, post-priming minNodes=10.
- Warmup concurrency=8, enable prefix caching for common prompts.
- Ingress: request timeout raised to 3s during scale windows.
- Operational playbook: if registry_429 > 2% -> rollback to serial startup OR enable local mirror.
- Cost: 3h elevated min nodes override in effect, finance notified.

Tom: I'll add the CA values to the runbook and tag this thread for the oncall handoff. Nice job team. :thumbsup:

Asha: Thanks all — leaving detailed logs and the final metrics in the runbook doc.
